svg.title: Systematic error: pH meter not calibrated
svg.text: Systematic error: pH meter not calibrated
The meter is offset by a fixed amount, so every pH reading is wrong by the same value
Error: the pH meter was not calibrated, so every reading is offset by the same amount (here +0.4).
Fix: calibrate with pH 7 buffer first, and a second buffer (pH 4 or 10), before measuring.
